keyFindings.description: Fixed by the reviewer (prose). blanksOutsideCode's comment said the two refusals refuse 'what they refused then, and nothing more'. The deep review found 6 documents main misread (typed blocks in an item in a footnote, ending in a whitespace-only last line) that are now refused, because directive.go now strips the typed block's indentation from that last line. The comment now says so.
Fixed by the reviewer (prose). blankInside's comment now names the exception that asHeldBefore makes.
Fixed by the reviewer (prose). fenceEndsEmptyAttr's comment now says why the segment stays: the counters of blank lines read it as main did.
Fixed by the reviewer (prose). One sentence added: blankInside and nestedQuotedListBlank still read held lines, and a last line lastLineColumns kept, as blank lines.

roundOneFindings: All 6 are fixed at 1852f6a4: directive.go:98 (dd60d85f), heldOpenBy shared with refusals.go (dd60d85f), checkCodeAndSpread shared harness (dd60d85f), changelog and AGENTS.md for lastLineColumns (1852f6a4), heldOpenBy citation (dd60d85f), and heldCodeLines/markBlocksAfterHeldCode split (dd60d85f). I replied on each of the 6 threads; the implementer had already resolved them.
acceptedNotBlocking: Quality Important 1: the rule that the refusals read the lines as main did is spread over asHeldBefore, blanksOutsideCode and the lastLineKeptAttr/keptLast flag. Maintainability only: no behaviour is wrong. The deep review found that it matches main's refusals over about 108,000 documents.

Quality Important 2: no committed test locks the refusal parity (asHeldBefore, the keptLast delete) or fenceEndsEmptyAttr. Removing each one still passes the suite, but some documents then change between refused and accepted. This is recorded in the PR body under Not proven / risk.

Quality Minor 4: the generator's no-line-feed ending survives deduplication about 1 time in 9, not 1 time in 3. The tester's noeol, noeol2 and typed corpora and the deep review's tab corpus cover the shape.

thermonuclear.deepReview: APPROVE. 0 critical, 0 important, 2 minor. About 108,000 documents run at the head, at round 1 and at main: 0 panics, no document main read correctly is newly refused or misread, and running time stays linear.
thermonuclear.codeQuality: CHANGES. All 5 round-1 items are resolved. 2 important (maintainability, and the missing regression tests) and 2 minor. I judged none of them blocking; see acceptedNotBlocking.
